results.text: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis on the Efficacy and Safety of Metformin as Add-on Therapy to Insulin in Patients With Type 1 Diabetes. This study aims to perform an updated meta-analysis evaluating the efficacy and safety of metformin adjunct therapy in type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM) patients. Cochrane, PubMed and Embase were searched for randomised controlled trials (RCTs) that reported the efficacy and safety of metformin in T1DM patients.
